top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a distinct invention, the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, whose many-atom, light-shift-free interrogation is not supplied by the 2005 comb or 2012 ion-control prizes. It has been realised at 10^-18 and independently reproduced in Sr, Yb and Hg laboratories, and the credit splits cleanly between Katori (concept) and Ye (record realisation) with no forced exclusion. P002 is a strong, reproduced discovery but its credit boundary (Cao and other experimental groups outside the three names) is harder to defend; P003 is mature but leaves the BHZ proposal and Hasan outside and overlaps the 2016 topology prize. Any of the three is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp
